scientific_integrity: Finite-state generator proof with independent exact-rational state-space checks; analytic inverse and attainable moment domain established for all finite N>=3. Time-rate scaling remains unidentifiable; historical priority not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Stationary exchangeable perfect-detection two-state sites with homogeneous local transition rates and conditionally independent clearing at Poisson shocks only.
One- and two-site static data do not identify catastrophe severity; three sites identify only normalized rates, not the common physical time scale.
Near zero per-shock removal probability, inverse sensitivity is singular; no finite-sample accuracy or estimation theorem is asserted.
Forward factorial moment formulas are classical; potentially relevant early full journal texts remain incompletely accessible.
title: Three patches sharply identify the severity and rate of synchronized partial habitat catastrophes
